🚨 Health Alert: Maharashtra issues advisory on Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) amidst global rise 🌍. Symptoms like cold, but severe for vulnerable groups. Stay safe: 🤧 Cover your cough, 🧼 Wash hands, 🏠 Avoid crowds. Awareness is key! 

#HMPV #
